## Checklist

- [ ] `node --test plugins/*/tests/*.test.mjs tests/*.test.mjs` passes
- [ ] Version bumped in `plugins/<name>/.claude-plugin/plugin.json` and `.claude-plugin/marketplace.json` (any behaviour change, including `SKILL.md` wording)
- [ ] Entry added to the plugin's `CHANGELOG.md`
- [ ] No safeguard removed or weakened (see CONTRIBUTING.md)
